PC anger (game.exe, docs/PC_ROUTINES.md "The anger and the bonus"): PCAngryTime on the Rottweiler is level_fitness/level.xml's angrytime=240 (1/12 s ticks: the level state ticks 12 times a second, as the HUD clock shows) — the rage current a trick without its own value is set to and the mercury's full scale; PCAngryTime on an item is its tricks.xml angrytime (ElectricTrap 264, GroundMarbles 288, Bicycle 288, Weights 264, GroundSkates 300); the profile holds the current 60 ticks, counts it down one per tick and pays +3 for a trick fired while it is above zero (pcprofile.s1_rage_*).
